overclaims: NIST's voluntary approach supports Marcus's narrower concern about United States governance, but cannot rescue the global wording.
checks.note: Excerpt, proposition, conditions, outcome and citations are fine. e1 (Art. 20/23, effective 2023-01-10) and e2 (Arts. 7-8, effective 2018-11-30) support the China sentences. The last rationale sentence gives Marcus a 'narrower concern about United States governance'. The statement and context never mention the US; they speak of government in general. e3 only shows that one NIST framework and playbook were voluntary, not a US 'approach'. 'Cannot rescue' is also loaded wording. Reword it as a conditional on a US-only reading.
